scope: O-marked Abelian cubic moduli, relative Veronese and Hom comparison, all-Artin cubic specialization, quadratic-flatness reduction, and first degree-three obstruction. New proofs reviewed; source closure rerun. Not a full independent audit of the existing manuscript.

review.definition: O-marked objects require existence of an admissible cubic ample sequence, not its choice. All pointed exact equivalences are admitted. The rank-three quadratic-center condition is restricted to a noncommutative chart; it excludes commutative cubic points. Full Abelian formal deformation theory is not identified with the cubic incidence essential image.
review.relative_veronese: Complete proof checked, including universal polynomial embedding, Cech intersection from P-flatness, nonreduced-base conic lifting, mu2 Isom torsor, grading-scalar sheaf quotient, and H1 versus H2 descent. An independent reading found no substantive error; section reconstruction on the conic was made explicit.
review.pointed_hom: Field Hom-groupoid comparison checked: exact equivalences preserve Serre, even orbit algebra, ample reconstruction, scalar kernel, and trivial pointed 2-inertia. Relative comparison is conditional on explicit C1-C4 over finite-type complex schemes with fppf topology. These inputs are not established over the full 17-parameter family.
review.formal_cubic: De Deken-Lowen Theorem4.5 and Proposition4.6 checked against published primary text. Cubic all-twist Ext1/Ext2 vanishing supplied. Arbitrary Artin coefficient-change lemma independently reviewed at Grothendieck and finitely presented levels. O-marking forgetful equivalence is classical 1-groupoid only, with explicit unframed-reduction convention.
review.envelope_reduction: Quadratic/cubic presentation and flat-envelope normal regular kernel proved using componentwise free modules and nilpotent Nakayama. Relative Koszul-AS lifting independently reviewed: actual syzygies, bilateral indices, bimodule resolution, base-flat module pd<=5, noetherian lifting, base change, and nonregular-base counterexample to absolute global dimension. Cubic presentation criterion is conditional on all-degree envelope flatness, which remains open.
review.degree_three_obstruction: Complete proof reviewed for B3=R^34 direct_sum R/I, I=Ann(g)=Fitt_34(B3), rank90 pivot reduction of a125x100 matrix, and at most10 obstruction coefficients. No assertion that degree-three flatness implies all-degree flatness. No new numerical certificate computed.
review.rigid_ambient_application: The O-marked four-parameter corollary uses retained rigid-ambient, finite-order THCR, PBW, low-center and regular-tails inputs. Saturation and Serre conditions are justified via the stated balanced dualizing complex and Yekutieli-Zhang local duality. The whole older rigid-ambient proof was not independently reconstructed in this review.
review.retained_results: Existing 41/37 and17/13 constructions, gcd-periodicity, finite-order regularity, Poisson component, conditional Artin hull and residual strategy retained. Their earlier computations and proof texts are not represented as newly rerun or newly fully audited.
review.novelty: The DDL specialization, LVdB deformation theory, general Serre/section reconstruction and Kummer facts are identified as known inputs. Priority or novelty of the new relative formulations and their combination remains unconfirmed.
